name: Knockout
note:
State #1 will be automatically added when
HP reaches 0.

note: SI_ElementalStates. Air. Hit -15%.

name: Venom
note: Loses 5% HP per turn and recovers half as much from healing. Centipede venom, euphorbia-coated blades. Dispel Herb cures it.

message1: 's skin begins to crust with salt!
message2: 's skin begins to crust with salt!
name: Salting
note:
Stoneman chiefs' salt glyph. Stiffening (AGI -30%). If it runs its course, the victim turns to salt (knocked out). Water washes it off: any water-sourced hit, or Fresh Water.
<Expires Into Knockout: %1 turns to salt!>
<Cured By Water>

name: Dragged Below
note:
Black Hounds (and the Daughters of the Wells). Out of the fight and out of reach. Hit whoever dragged them to pull them free; if no one does in 3 turns, they are lost (knocked out).
<Released When Inflicter Hit>
<Expires Into Knockout: %1 is dragged into the dark!>

name: Entangled
note: Loses its next turn (nets).

name: Bleed
note: Loses 6% HP per turn. Bandages stop it.

name: Dazzled
note: Blinding light (Children of the Caves). Hit -50% until the end of its next turn.

name: Stunned
note: Loses its next turn. A Sodden target hit by an electric technique (SI_Voltaic).

name: Tipsy
note:
All-Seafarer Grog. Hit -10%, but resists Despair and Panicked (liquid courage).
Another drink while Tipsy: Disoriented.
<Stacks Into: Disoriented>

name: Pointed Out
note:
Patience is pointing at it: the party's next damaging hit on it is a critical.
<Exposed>

name: Held
note:

<No Flee>

name: Confused
note:

<Flee: 10>

name: Hypnotized
note: Mental. The Bull of Water's gaze: attacks its own allies. A hit may snap it out (50%). Dispel Herb cures it.

name: Sleep
